units: <cite ref="Pesachim 55b:7">Pes. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>פרח צ׳ מינה</he> her heat has left her (the breeding hen’s desire to hatch is gone).
<cite ref="Chullin 51a:10">Ḥull. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ בעלמא הוא וכ׳</he> it is merely the fever (from the inflicted wound) that has seized them (and we need apprehend no injury to a vital organ).

<cite ref="Gittin 69b:19">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ ברא</he> outside fever (eruption); <he>צ׳ גוונא</he> inner fever; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="R00472"><he>צִימְרֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="R00383"><he>צִמְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 69b:19">Ib.</cite> <he>דמעליא לכולהו צ׳</he> Rashi (ed. <cite ref="R00383"><he>צימרא</he></cite>, corr. acc.) it is good for all kinds of fever.
